page.overview:
Who is Ekomal Cin?

Ekomal Cin was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a follower of Axkva Min.

Ekomal Cin was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Ekomal Cin was added to the game as part of the "Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter,
